Description

This PR sits on top of #14752 in the refreshable-token stack. Until now the stack pinned a pre-release pseudo-version of cli/oauth. The changes are now released, so this moves gh to the tagged version:

  • github.com/cli/oauth v1.3.0: the token expiry fields are now time.Duration values, so internal/authflow converts them when building the stored credential. Refresh also keeps the previous refresh token when the server omits a new one, which the godoc and the related test now reflect.

github.com/cli/go-gh/v2 v2.17.0 is already on trunk via #14148. As expected, that release was a breaking change for gh because it moved its markdown package to Glamour v2 (cli/go-gh#281), and #14148 took care of the migration.

This PR also fixes a small gh status regression from that migration. Lip Gloss v2 counts borders within Width, so the bordered left column became one cell narrower than the right one and truncated rows wrapped onto a second line. The left column is now one cell wider, and the status_test.go expectations are restored to what they were before #14148.

How did you test this change?

Not tested by hand. I have not run gh status or the auth commands interactively against this branch.

Key points

  • The gh status fix is unrelated to oauth, but it is small and keeps the go-gh/Glamour follow-up in one place before release.

Notes for reviewers

Start with internal/authflow/refresh.go for the oauth change, then pkg/cmd/status/status.go for the one-line width fix. The status_test.go diff only moves the column divider back by one cell and unwraps the truncated rows.

Authorship and follow-up

What changed in this PR

Changes:

  • Update documentation and tests for refresh-token reuse.
  • Restore status column width and expected output.
